title: Omwoyo Omugonvu Mu Bannabbi
intro: Eddoboozi eriyita obutuukirivu liwulikika okuyita mu Aya za Quran ey’Ekitiibwa. Omwoyo guno ogw’omukisa gwaweebwa obunnabbi n’ebyawandiikibwa eby’obwakatonda mu kiseera ng’obulagirizi bwetaagibwa ennyo mu Baana ba Isirayiri. Ono ssekinnoomu yayogera butereevu n’abantu baabwe, ng’abakubiriza okutuuka ku kujjukira Mukama waabwe. Okuyita mu bugumiikiriza n’okwewaayo, baafuuka ettaala y’ekitangaala emboozi yaayo eyaka empapula z’ebyawandiikibwa ebitukuvu. Osobola okuzuula omuntu ono ow’ekitalo erinnya lye eriweebwa ekitiibwa mu Quran ne mu Njiri?
clues: Naweebwa ekitiibwa n’obunnabbi n’ekitabo eky’omu ggulu mu kiseera ky’abantu bange nga beetaaga.
Maama yanzaala mu ngeri eyeewuunyisa, ng’ayita mu kiragiro kya Allah kyokka.
Nayogera eri abantu bange nga ŋŋamba nti ‘Abange Abaana ba Isirayiri! Nze ndi mubaka wa Allah gye muli, nga nkakasa ebyo ebyajja mu maaso gange.’
Najja n’obubonero obw’olwatu okuva eri Mukama wammwe, nga nleeta amawulire ag’essanyu aga Nabbi erinnya lye eryandibadde Ahmad.
Maama yali mukazi mutuukirivu eyanneewaayo okuweereza Allah okuva mu buto bwange.
Allah yanjigiriza Quran n’anfuula omusaasizi era ow’emirimu eri maama wange, era saali mugulumivu wadde omujeemu.

options: Nabbi Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم

arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ يَـٰبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ إِنِّى رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ إِلَيْكُم مُّصَدِّقًۭا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَىَّ مِنَ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ وَمُبَشِّرًۢا بِرَسُولٍۢ يَأْتِى مِنۢ بَعْدِى ٱسْمُهُۥٓ أَحْمَدُ ۖ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ قَالُوا۟ هَـٰذَا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verse: And [mention] when Jesus, the son of Mary, said, "O Children of Israel, indeed I am the messenger of Allāh to you confirming what came before me of the Torah and bringing good tidings of a messenger to come after me, whose name is Aḥmad." But when he came to them with clear evidences, they said, "This is obvious magic." (61:6)
